use.flag: Link against the system OpenSSL. Otherwise build the bundled copy. Disabling it requires the bundled libcurl, libgit2, and libssh2, so system-libcurl, system-libgit2, and system-libssh2 must be disabled too.
Link against the system libcurl. Otherwise build the bundled copy, which requires the bundled OpenSSL (system-openssl disabled) and the bundled zlib (system-zlib disabled).
Link against system libgit2 1.9.x. Otherwise build the bundled copy. Requires system-libssh2, because the system libgit2 brings its own libssh2.
Link against the system libssh2. Otherwise build the bundled copy.
Link against the system zlib. Otherwise build the bundled copy.
Link against the system SQLite. Otherwise build the bundled copy.
Install with a runtime dependency on libsecret for registry credentials.
